items.name: Back on Your Feet
items.description: While at 0 HP, stand back up at the start of your turn with 1 HP.

items.name: Lucky Find
items.description: Introduce a small, useful detail or item into the scene (GM's call).

items.name: Dig Deep
items.description: Regain hit points equal to your level. Costs 1 more each time this session.

items.name: Flaw: Bad Habit
items.description: Your character's flaw causes real trouble for the party this scene. Describe how.
